_description: Reproducible behaviour worth a future debugger's time: symptoms seen, root cause found, fix applied. Includes recurring footguns (the footgun IS the symptom). Append only; prefer a new entry over editing when understanding evolves.

title: Vite serves a stale module after container recreate or new lib export
symptoms: Uncaught SyntaxError: does not provide an export named X
UI renders old markup after a source change
root_cause: Vite keeps a pre-optimized dependency graph in node_modules/.vite; the running dev server serves it even after the source changed.
fix: Clear node_modules/.vite in the container and 'docker compose up -d --force-recreate app', then hard-refresh the browser.

title: Carbon silently overflows out-of-range dates and throws on garbage
symptoms: Imported asset lands in the wrong year (e.g. 2026-13-99 becomes 2027-04-09)
Uncaught exception on an unparseable date string
root_cause: Carbon::createFromFormat('Y-m-d', ...) overflows invalid date parts instead of rejecting, and throws (not returns null) on unparseable input.
fix: Validate by round-tripping: reject when $date->format('Y-m-d') !== input; wrap in try/catch and skip on throw. See parseDate() in ImportCsv.

title: Test suite could wipe the real dev DB via container env vars
symptoms: RefreshDatabase pointed at the bind-mounted dev database instead of in-memory
root_cause: The container exports DB_CONNECTION/DB_DATABASE as process env, which override phpunit.xml and .env.testing.
fix: tests/TestCase.php::createApplication() forces database.default=sqlite and :memory: at boot. Do not remove this override.

title: European decimal format mis-parsed on CSV import
root_cause: Naive str_replace(',', '.') ignores the thousands separator; export writes number_format(v, 2, ',', '.').
fix: Detect the rightmost of '.'/',' as the decimal separator and strip the other as thousands. See parseDecimal() in ImportCsv.

title: Scheduled prices:fetch never ran — schedule defined but no runner
symptoms: Live prices only update on the manual 'Aggiorna prezzi' button
fetched_at stays at the last manual refresh despite a daily 06:00 schedule
root_cause: routes/console.php defines Schedule::command('prices:fetch')->dailyAt('06:00'), but the container start command and composer dev ran serve/queue/pail/vite without 'php artisan schedule:work', so nothing executed the schedule.
fix: Add 'php artisan schedule:work' to the concurrently process list in docker-compose.yml and composer.json (dev). Verify with a standalone schedule:work process in the container and 'php artisan schedule:list'.

title: Http::fake() called twice doesn't replace the first stub; fakeSequence + retry() consumes extra items
symptoms: A second Http::fake() in one test still returns the first stub's response
A test using fakeSequence with a client that has ->retry() exhausts the sequence and the request 500s/throws
root_cause: Http::fake() merges stubs rather than replacing; retry() makes multiple requests that each pull a sequence item.
fix: Per test, set one Http::fake with a wildcard, or seed DB state directly instead of chaining two fakes. Avoid fakeSequence when the client retries, or push enough items to cover attempts.
